title: Jubilant Sour German Pistachio Skewers
description: A Whole30-friendly, sour, and bouncy German dish featuring pistachio, perfect for festive occasions. This recipe uses dehydration to bring out the flavors.
instructions: Preheat the dehydrator to 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, coconut aminos, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pistachios to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pistachios onto skewers, leaving a small space between each pistachio.
Place the skewers in the dehydrator and dehydrate for 6 hours.
After 6 hours, remove the skewers from the dehydrator and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the Jubilant Sour German Pistachio Skewers immediately and enjoy.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
